== Village link ==

A '''village link''' is a two-ended web object expressing a same-entity assertion between two resources.

Conceptually:

<pre>
A ← W → B
</pre>

where '''W''' is the village link and '''A''' and '''B''' are its two endpoints.

A conventional hyperlink points from one web object to one resource. A village link points from one web object to two resources. The relationship asserted between those endpoints is equivalence of entity: they are presented as references to the same entity in different contexts or memory systems.

The reference publisher records these assertions; interpretation and decisions about whether to trust them remain separate concerns.

See also [[VillageLink:Star credential]].
